decisions.decision: Use a single pinned validated ledger and object-by-object Ripple-owned escrow read as the canonical stock. Store each EscrowFinish and EscrowCreate as separate event flows. Flag any dashboard summary that disagrees with the pinned object sum.
decisions.reason: The main Radar summary says 30.4B while the detailed page at ledger 108,052,148 says 31.1B; the 700M difference matches three later EscrowCreate transactions.

decisions.decision: Store gross released, re-escrowed, and net-out-of-escrow separately. Do not equate net out with sale, spot supply, or exchange inflow.
decisions.reason: November 1 released 1B, re-escrowed 700M, net 300M. Destination and disposition remain unknown.

decisions.decision: Label broad not-escrowed/not-burned supply separately from free float and from vendor circulating supply definitions.
decisions.reason: The derived 68.8856B does not subtract operational Ripple holdings, exchange custody, lost/inaccessible XRP or other encumbrances.

decisions.decision: Store distributed transferable token float separately from represented registry notional and issuer-reported valuations.
decisions.reason: The $4.33B RWA headline consists of $276M distributed and $4.06B represented; only about 6.37% is distributed.

decisions.decision: Treat attributed exchange wallet totals as a public-wallet floor and custody concentration measure, not tradable float or exchange net flows.
decisions.reason: Omnibus deposits, cold storage, cbXRP backing and Binance-Peg reserves may be included; unlabeled wallets are excluded.
